excel.meta.title: SBOMcraft Packages export
excel.guide.1: 1. Edit the Packages / Checksums / ExternalRefs sheets. The SPDXID column (gray) is the row key, so do not change it (sorting and filtering are fine).
excel.guide.2: 2. You may reorder columns or delete columns you do not need. Do not change the headings in row 1. Fields without a heading column are left unchanged.
excel.guide.3: 3. [Packages] Clearing a cell removes that field from the SBOM. However, name and downloadLocation are required (use NOASSERTION if unknown).
excel.guide.4: 4. [Packages] Adding or deleting rows has no effect. Rows whose SPDXID is not in the SBOM are ignored, and rows deleted from Excel are not deleted from the SBOM.
excel.guide.5: 5. All cells are formatted as text. Pasting values as numbers or dates may change the original notation (e.g. 1.10 → 1.1).
excel.guide.6: 6. [Checksums / ExternalRefs] One element = one row. The rows with the same SPDXID make up that package's list. The name column is for reference only; changes to it are ignored.
excel.guide.7: 7. [Same sheets] To add an element, add (copy) a row with the same SPDXID and fill it in. Packages without elements have an empty row prepared for input.
excel.guide.8: 8. [Same sheets] Deleting a row removes that element from the SBOM. However, if you delete all rows of a package, it is treated as “no change”.
excel.guide.8b: To empty a list, keep exactly one row for that package and clear all of its values.
excel.guide.9: 9. [Same sheets] An element whose values you change is treated as “delete + add” (the added element is appended to the end of the list). Reordering is not applied.
excel.guide.10: 10. On import, only new or changed elements are validated (algorithm type, hash length and hexadecimal format, purl prefix, etc.). A list with errors is not applied for that package.
excel.guide.11: 11. When you import into SBOMcraft, you can review the list of changes (preview) before they are applied.
excel.example.note.hash: Hashes are hexadecimal. SHA1 = 40 digits / SHA256 = 64 / SHA512 = 128 / MD5 = 32
excel.example.note.locator: purl starts with pkg: ; cpe23Type starts with cpe:2.3:
